574-1981-2415-7918.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-7918.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

728-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
728-5968-5972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-7060-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-7060-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

254-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
254-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, First Day of Class triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Cat.
Repeat from step 4, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

5147-5500-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-5500-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-2438-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

1796-4217-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 3.

4871-7072-7297.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

3259-4373-6791.description:

Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1849-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1849-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1796-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3062-3557-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-3557-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

826-1399-1606-6984.notablePrerequisites: Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it. You control at least three creatures.
826-1399-1606-6984.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo, Waking Haven.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-2478-4359.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2275-3375-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

5073-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2173-2459-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1987-4423-5139-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-2048-2267-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2048-2267-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

856-2829-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

647-1069-1256-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
647-1069-1256-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-2034-3484-4023-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five energy counters.
1636-2034-3484-4023-4840.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module trigger four times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1631-2660-4050-4924.notablePrerequisites: Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1631-2660-4050-4924.description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier, adding {W}.
Battalion Foot Soldier is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Battalion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, searching your library for Battalion Foot Soldier and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

243-628-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it
Repeat.

233-714-3750.notablePrerequisites: Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{R}.
233-714-3750.description:
Activate all mana producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this phase.
Repeat.
